batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c NK Patel b MM Patel

batting.name: W Jaffer
batting.dismissal: c LA Carseldine b A Singh

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b LA Carseldine

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c M Morkel b RA Jadeja

batting.name: D du Preez
batting.dismissal: c NK Patel b A Singh

batting.name: YK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c W Jaffer b D du Preez

balls.text: Amit's bowled him with another slower one, that's his fourth wicket. It was full and straight, Vinay swung across the line and missed, all six balls in the last over were slower ones
and yet another slower ball, Amit's used them well today, Vinay tries to blast it through the off side but misses
full and wide ball outside off stump, the batsman tries to reverse sweep and is no where close to making contact
the batsman slogs across the line and gets two runs towards deep midwicket

caught in the deep! Amit bowled another slower ball outside off, du Preez waited for it before lofting down the ground, he may have spotted the slower one but he still didn't time it well, Niraj took an easy catch and didn't fumble it this time
Vinay Kumar tries to move outside off and chip the ball over short fine leg, he realises he can't do it and plays the ball awkwardly towards short third man
Warne ends the over with a slider and nearly beats du Preez
flicked off the pads behind square
now he tries to sweep and doesn't make good contact
Vinay Kumar steps out of his crease and swings through the line, he makes good contact and sends the ball over the long-on boundary
a flighted delivery on leg stump, the batsman plays it behind square leg
played off the front foot behind point
played towards point on the back foot, Morne's bowled a maiden over
defended on the front foot
Vinay Kumar fends and gets beaten outside off stump
defended on the back foot

he's run him out! Morkel bowled a full and straight delivery, Praveen hit it straight back to the bowler and incredibly set off for the run, what was he thinking, Morkel took a moment, perhaps in disbelief, and then threw down the stumps at the striker's end, Praveen actually didn't know where the ball had gone after the yorker hit him on the boot
Praveen backs away to make room (or maybe he was getting out of the line of the ball!) and slashes, he gets beaten by the pace and bounce
Amit was looking for the yorker but bowled a full toss, played on the leg side
oh my! Praveen gets a short ball first up and pulls it over the midwicket boundary, it's been a while since we had one of those sixes, only the second of the innings
that's an outstanding change of pace! 102 kmh! Roelof was swinging across the line even before the ball pitched, he missed and the ball uprooted leg stump
Amit bowls one in the blockhole, forcing du Preez to chop it out towards point, it was slower as well, just the single
Roelof wanted to smash it but was done in by the slower one, he managed to get it away behind square on the leg side
full ball on off stump, du Preez drives through cover for one
a fraction short this time, du Preez goes back in his crease and drives towards long on, Bangalore need to do something about their run-rate, it's still below six
du Preez gets on to the front foot and drives towards long off once again
tossed up on middle stump, Roelof nudges towards point and gets another single
driven firmly off the front foot towards long off for one
du Preez opens the face and plays the ball to short third man
Roelof pushes off the front foot towards cover and sets off for one
du Preez buts but this time Morkel dives to his left at short third man and makes the save
du Preez pushes towards Morkel at short third man and Roelof calls him through for a single, Morkel throws towards the bowler's end and concedes an over throw
Jadeja angles the ball into off stump, du Preez defends on the front foot
Roelof drives firmly through cover off the front foot
pushed towards deep point for a single

that's a super catch! Virat cuts from outside off stump and the ball goes in the air towards short third man, it's a flat chance and Morkel bends down low to take a sharp catch, he's really tall and did well to take that just before it hit the ground
fuller and straighter, Virat nudges towards midwicket
super ball, Morkel finds the length that makes Virat unsure of whether to play on the front or back foot, he fends and gets beaten outside off
Roelof waits on the back foot and glances the ball towards third man
Virat plays the short of a length ball behind point to give the strike back to Roelof
good length this time on off stump, Roelof stays in his crease and hits the ball to mid-on
that's short and very wide, Roelof can't reach it, Harper says that's wide
Roelof stands in his crease and cuts a short and wide ball over point for four, Bangalore desperately need momentum
just the single to end the over, Roelof works another flat and quick delivery towards square leg
Virat plays the ball off his pads for one more
nudged towards square leg for a single
Roelof tries to hammer the ball on the leg side but was early on the shot, he hits it with the toe of the bat towards the bowler
defended on the front foot towards the bowler, Jadeja's bowling wicket to wicket
Jadeja angles the ball into Roelof, not giving him room, he plays the ball towards point
that was the faster straighter delivery, Roelof drives from the crease through the off side
played off the back foot through the leg side
Virat drives hard towards cover but the shot is stopped by Jadeja
Virat gives Warne the charge, it was a slower ball and he got under it before lofting cleanly to the straight boundary
Warne slips in the slider, Virat was playing for turn and got beaten
Roelof waits for the ball from Warne  to spin across him before cutting to deep point
Roelof gets off the mark first ball by tapping a full toss towards long-on, he likes to smash it but will he temper his approach today?
bowled him! Jadeja bowls a fuller, straighter and faster ball, it's too close to cut and Boucher gets a bottom edge on to the stumps, that's a huge loss for Bangalore, their tail is a wicket away
slower from Jadeja and wider outside off stump, Boucher reaches out for it and drives through cover, Smith's in the deep
pushed off the pads for one on the leg side
Virat plays the ball towards point for a single this time, these two were team-mates at the U-19 World Cup
pushed off the back foot towards the off side, Jadeja's pushing them through flat and quick
played on the leg side for  a single
Ojha's dropped the bottom edge! Virat tried to pull the ball as it turned across him but got a thick bottom edge, tough one and Ojha couldn't take it
tossed up on middle stump, Boucher nudges towards midwicket
Boucher tries to sweep but misses this time
Boucher waits for the flighted delivery and works it into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
nudged off the pads towards short fine leg, there's no single there but it's Munaf doing the fielding and the batsmen take advantage
defended on the front foot, Jadeja ends a successful first over
Virat flicks a full ball off his toes through square leg
played with an open face behind point for a single
pushed on the off side off the front foot
Boucher's the new batsman and he's off the mark by moving back and working the ball towards square leg

and he's trapped Uthappa plumb in front with his first ball! Uthappa tried to close the face and play the straighter one on the leg side, he missed and got hit in front of middle, the umpire's finger was up in a flash
Uthappa tries to slog sweep this time, he makes contact but loses balance as he completes the shot, that didn't look comfortable
Warne's yelled one of his trademark appeals, Uthappa tried to cut but got hit on the pad before the ball went on to the bat, luckily for him the impact was just outside off
this time Virat manages to drive the flighted delivery from middle and of towards long-off
Warne gives the ball air and drifts it into middle stump, Virat defends watchfully
slow through the air, and straighter, Virat defends on the front foot
he gets the ball to turn quite a bit and Virat lets it go outside off
midwicket has no chance this time and boy did he time that! Uthappa latches on to a short ball and pulls it hard along the ground for four, two in a row now
Uthappa stands his ground and swats a length delivery past the bowler, he hasn't timed it well but the outfield is so fast that mid-on and mid-off have no chance
Munaf bowls a bouncer, is it a touch too high? It is a little down leg side? It's high and that's a wide, Munaf's not happy but that was very high
fuller and wider outside off stump, Uthappa chases it and tries to cut but misses
he tries to do it again but misses and gets hit on the thigh
short of a length and straight, Uthappa tries to work the ball off the back foot on the leg side but doesn't make proper contact
Munaf bowls a short of a length delivery which beats Uthappa for bounce as the batsman tries to cut
Virat Kohli gets a bouncer first up and lets it go through to Ojha

caught down the leg side! Carseldine pitched the ball outside leg once again and moved the ball towards the batsman, Dravid tried to play the leg glance but the ball thudded into his glove and went towards the wicketkeeper, Naman Ojha dived to his left to take a sharp catch
Uthappa moves back and opens the face to steer the ball towards third man
Carseldine pitches outside leg stump and seams the ball towards the batsman, it's still down leg though and that's a wide
that's too full and Uthappa has room to free his arms, he whacks the ball in the air and dead straight, he'll get four for that
good length from Carseldine, defended back towards the bowler
full ball on middle and leg, nearly a yorker, dug out by the batsman
good length on off stump, Dravid gets behind the line and defends on the off side
played on the leg side for a single to give Dravid strike

that's gone miles in the air and it's been caught on the second attempt! Kallis tried to pull the ball but was a touch early on the shot, the top edge swirled high in the air towards deep backward square leg, Niraj Patel went for the catch and fumbled it at first attempt, he managed to recover in time and grabbed it ten inches from the ground
Kallis charges and drives the ball hard towards mid-off, he's going after Munaf
massive appeal for a caught behind, there were two noises, Kallis tried to cut the ball but there was no room whatsoever, the ball brushed the top of the pad, good decision from umpire Hariharan
he feeds Kallis on his pads and gets dispatched over the square leg boundary with the sweetest of flicks, superb timing, that's the first six of the match
another short ball outside off stump, Uthappa tries to cut but gets beaten by the bounce
Morkel bangs it in short at Uthappa who gets into a weird position to play the ball, he begins to push at it from his crease before pulling the bat out of the way
defended on the back foot on the leg side, Uthappa runs through for the single
Kallis has hammered that! He smashes it off the front foot towards cover but Raut didn't let it get past him

short of a length angling into the batsman, Uthappa stays in his crease and defends towards point, Jadeja fields and unleashes a throw at the bowler's end, he scores a direct hit but concedes an overthrow off the rebound, that was quite needless
Kallis gets cramped for room as he plays the ball towards third man, Morne's troubling the batsman with bounce
defended on the off side off the front foot, Uthappa always plays off the front foot (nearly always)
Uthappa walks down the pitch to the free-hit, trying to do a Hayden and smash it over midwicket, Amit beats him with pace and bounce, Bangalore waste a free hit

dropped again but it doesn't matter because it's a no-ball, Amit oversteps while bowling a short ball, Kallis charges and pulls, he gets a top edge towards wide mid-on, Munaf back-pedals and makes a hash of a straight-forward chance, free hit coming up ...
Kallis tries to muscle a short of a length delivery through cover point but can't pierce the in-field
he's off the mark right away, flicking a ball from middle and leg on the leg side

caught! Amit's made up for that dropped catch, he bowled a good length ball on off stump, Jaffer tried to drive off the front foot but totally mis-timed it, he ended up spooning an easy catch to Lee Carseldine at short cover, soft dismissal that
good length outside off, Jaffer watchfully lets it go through to the wicketkeeper
Morkel jags the ball back into Jaffer's body, he fends it off towards the leg side and sets off for a run
pushed towards the leg side on the back foot

dropped!, that's poor judgment from Amit on the fine-leg boundary, Jaffer flicked the half-volley on the pads in the air towards fine leg, Amit ran in two far and then had to jump as the ball sailed over his head, it pitched once before going over the boundary
137 km on a good length around off stump, Kallis can't do much with that but defend on the off side
short of a length angling into the hips, Jaffer tucks it off his pads behind square for one
on a good length on off and middle stump, defended from the crease towards the bowler
Kallis charges to try and whack the ball over cover but gets beaten by the extra bounce once again, tidy start from Amit
the ball rears up from a good length, catching Kallis by surprise, he defends on the off side
that's short and wide, so wide that Kallis can't reach it, he tried to smash that through point, Amit will have to re-bowl that one
Kallis moves across his stumps to work a ball from outside off towards the leg side, he wasn't able to connect firmly with the flick though
fuller length angling into off stump, Jaffer leans forward and defends on the off side, he looks up and Kallis who responds and they steal the quick single
this one is straighter and the length is a bit short, Kallis moves back into his crease and plays the ball gently wide of midwicket
Amit pitches short of a length outside off stump and gets a bit of movement away from the right-hander, the batsman shoulders arms
that's the end of the game! Ojha finishes it by pulling the short ball to the midwicket boundary, back-to-back fifties for him, well played!
is that six? Ojha made room and slashed the ball with tremendous bat speed, the ball flew flat and bounced on the rope, so that's a six
Ojha waits for the short one, picks his spot, and pulls the ball into the gap at deep midwicket
Jadeja waits for another short one and pulls towards deep square leg
short once again but down leg side this time, another wide, just 14 needed now
short of a length outside off stump, played off the back foot to point
Praveen sends down a bouncer at Jadeja who sways out of the way
the batsman backs away to make room but gets beaten outside off stump

right, are the other bowlers watching? du Preez bowls another short one which doesn't bounce as much, Yusuf tries to pull but gets a top edge towards long leg were Jaffer takes the catch, Yusuf has looked suspect against the short balls today
defended on the off side
short ball and this time Yusuf swivels and pulls the ball flat towards the long-leg boundary
Ojha plays the ball towards point for a single
he bowls a short one but it doesn't bounce much, Yusuf pulls towards long leg
yorker to end the over, Ojha plays it out on the off side
banged in short angling into the right-hander, Yusuf gets cramped for room but manages to steer the ball towards third man
Vinay bounces Yusuf this time but that ball is far too high even for a tall batsman like Yusuf, wide called
fuller length on middle and leg, Ojha flicks off his pads through midwicket
Vinay replies with the bouncer, forcing Ojha to take cover
shot! Ojha backs away a touch, just enough to make room, and hits through the line, it didn't go off the middle but the ball had enough on it to fly over the long-off boundary
good length on off stump, Ojha defends off the front foot towards cover
Kallis cramps Yusuf for room with one that slants into the right-hander, Yusuf defends from his crease towards cover
Ojha stands on his toes on the back foot and plays the short ball towards fine leg
fuller this time on middle and leg stump, Yusuf plays the ball through square leg
It's short again but the line is down leg side, Yusuf misses the pull but a wide is called
Ojha steps back to a short ball and nudges down to third man
now it's short and Yusuf plays the ball awkwardly towards third man
no, it's a full ball and Yusuf leans forward and drives the ball powerfully to the cover boundary
fuller to Ojha and the batsman drives towards deep cover, Kallis is the fielder and the batsmen risk taking two
short again outside off stump, Yusuf stands in his crease and chips the ball in the air towards third man, it falls short of the fielder but yusuf isn't looking at ease against the short ball
Praveen continues with the short stuff, this one is outside off, Yusuf lets it go
Praveen gives him another short ball, Yusuf tries to pull but misses
short ball and Yusuf gets out of the way
Yusuf stands tall and cuts the ball in the air behind point, Kallis runs to his left in the deep and dives, he can't get there in time
played towards long-on for a single
Yusuf drives on the front foot towards deep cover
played on the off side for one more
Ojha charges Roelof and smashes him high in the air, the ball stays airborne for a long time and when it comes down it falls just over the long-off boundary
Roelof angles the ball into the right-hander and Ojha gets hit on the pad as he tries to play on the leg side
Yusuf mis-hits the ball towards mid-on and runs the single
Yusuf gets down on one knee and sweeps, he's placed the shot fine but the fielder does well to slide on his belly and drag it back in
defended back to the bowler on the front foot

that's an awful mix-up and Carseldine has to go, or is it Ojha? Carseldine pushed the ball towards mid-off and set off for the single, Ojha was ball watching and Carseldine kept running, both batsmen were at the same end when Virat threw the ball to Boucher, it's Ojha who's walking off, now he's waiting, it looked as though Ojha was back in his crease, the third umpire has to decide, it looks like one of those photo finishes and it is Carseldine who is out in the end, bizarre mix-up
Carseldine moves back and across and defends towards the bowler
played towards deep backward square leg for one
Ojha takes a quick step down the track and hits the ball very hard past the bowler, that's a good shot, his best today
good length ball angling into the right-hander, Ojha jumps back and plays the ball through square leg
good length on off stump, Carseldine moves forward and drives through cover
played towards fine leg for another single
Ojha backs away to pull but misses and gets hit on the pad
Ojha tries to pull but gets an inside edge past his stumps, the batsmen run a very risky run and get an overthrow

Carseldine's pulled that with some power and hit the leg umpire! Hariharan was motionless at square leg until the ball thudded into him, he tried to get out of the way rather late, despite the deflection, the ball nearly reached the boundary
Ojha tries to sweep but misses
fancy footwork! Ojha gets an inside edge that might have gone on to his stumps, he reacts quickly and kicks the ball away in time
that's in the air but wide of the man at midwicket, Ojha pushed forward firmly and the ball went in the air on the leg side
Carseldine nudges a full ball through midwicket to get off strike
bowled slowly through the air on middle and off, defended on the front foot
driven off the front foot through cover for a single
good length delivery angling across the left-hander, Carseldine lets it go through to the wicketkeeper
Kallis gives Carseldine a half-volley on leg stump which the batsman glances to the fine-leg boundary to get off the mark
bowled him! Smith charges and tries to swing Kallis on the leg side, the ball pitches on a length and Smith misses it completely, the stumps are in a mess
Ojha gets cramped by the ball angling into his body but manages to nudge it towards the leg side for one
Smith plays the ball towards wide mid-off and calls Ojha for the single
Smith defends watchfully towards the bowler, Kallis' bowling average is 91 at the moment!
good length on leg and middle, Smith moves back and plays the ball towards deep square leg
Smith rocks back and pulls hard, this time he finds the fielder at midwicket
full and straight from du Preez, Smith waits in his crease and drives the ball firmly, mid-on dives to his right but can't cut it off
Smith jumps out of his crease and defends towards the bowler
Smith moves smoothly on to the front foot and drives the ball wide of mid-off for four
Ojha moves towards leg and pushes the ball on the off side
Smith fends at a good length ball outside off stump but gets beaten

has that been caught? If so it's a stupendous catch! Ojha made room to a short ball and played the upper cut towards third man, Roelof (or was it du Preez?) came sprinting in from the boundary and dived forward full length to try and take the catch, replays show the ball bounced just before entering his hands so Ojha's will survive
Kallis replies with the short ball and Ojha ducks under it
Ojha backs away once again and tries to loft the ball over the off side, he doesn't time it but manages to clear the infield
Ojha backs away and tries to cut a ball that's very close to off stump, he gets a bottom edge into the ground towards slip
Ojha stays in his crease and plays the ball towards point
defended on the off side to end the over
and here's the second! Smith swivels and pulls the short ball towards deep square leg, Vinay Kumar slides but fumbles on the boundary
short ball just outside off stump, Smith jumps down the track, makes room, and slaps the ball through cover for the first boundary of the innings
Praveen bowls the slower one on middle stump which Smith drives towards mid-on
shorter and wider outside off, Smith cuts hard but hits it to Virat at point
Smith moves out of his crease and drives a length delivery towards cover, Rajasthan are starting slowly but they can afford to
Smith nudges the ball towards midwicket for one more
Smith moves forward and towards the off and chips the ball in the air towards mid-off, the ball falls short of the fielder
Smith moves back in his crease and defends on the leg side
Ojha backs away to make room and guides the ball towards third man
that falls just short! Ojha was hurried by the short one and he mis-hit the pull, the top edge fell short of Jaffer who was running in from square leg
Ojha tries to cut without moving his feet and gets beaten outside off
Ojha backs away to make a bit of room and plays the ball towards cover point, he's away with a single
full ball with a bit of swing into the right-hander, Ojha defends on the off side from his crease
Smith drops the ball with soft hands towards cover and calls Ojha through for one
good length outside off stump, left alone by Smith
fuller length on off stump, Smith moves forward and blocks on the off side, Praveen runs across and fields
good length but there's room outside off stump for the left-hander, Smith cuts but can't beat point
